items.headline: Mistral AI raises €3B at €21B valuation in Europe's largest-ever tech funding round
items.summary: Mistral closed a Samsung-led €3 billion round, nearly doubling its valuation from a year earlier, to expand compute, build data centers and scale its enterprise 'neocloud' business as European sovereign AI becomes a bigger commercial bet.

items.headline: Qualcomm signs $60B AI chip deal with Amazon
items.summary: Qualcomm and Amazon struck a long-term partnership under which Amazon could buy up to $60 billion of custom AI inference chips and optical networking gear for its data centers, with Qualcomm also issuing Amazon roughly $4 billion in stock warrants, as cloud giants keep diversifying away from Nvidia.

items.headline: Anthropic says Chinese AI labs ran industrial-scale distillation attacks on Claude
items.summary: Anthropic's latest threat intelligence report accuses seven China-based labs, including Alibaba, DeepSeek and Moonshot AI, of covertly extracting Claude's capabilities through roughly 200 million exchanges, with Alibaba's campaign alone generating over 151 million interactions to clone Claude's reasoning and coding skills.

items.headline: Meta acquires Swedish AI agent startup Stilla.ai
items.summary: Meta is buying eight-month-old Stilla, whose AI agents integrate with tools like Slack and GitHub to retain organizational context, to accelerate Meta Business Agent, the assistant that already handles over a billion business conversations a day on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram.

items.headline: Sakana AI launches Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 multi-agent orchestration models
items.summary: Sakana AI split its Fugu system into two models that route tasks across a pool of open and specialized models rather than relying on one monolithic network, with Ultra v2 aimed at hard multi-step tasks and cutting inference costs by roughly 60%.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases V4.1 Flash with 1-million-token context window
items.summary: DeepSeek launched V4.1 Flash, a 552-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with native vision support that outperforms V4-Pro on benchmarks while cutting costs, with open weights published to Hugging Face under an MIT license.

items.headline: Anthropic researcher's resignation reignites AI existential-risk debate
items.summary: After a researcher resigned warning that colleagues 'earnestly believe' AI could kill all humans within a decade, Anthropic's alignment lead publicly backed a greater-than-10% probability estimate, drawing pushback from academics who call such figures speculative marketing.

items.headline: Google launches native Gemini app for Windows
items.summary: Google brought a dedicated Gemini desktop app to Windows 10 and 11 with an Alt+Space overlay shortcut, Gmail/Drive/Calendar integration, and Nano Banana image generation, following its macOS launch earlier this year and stepping up competition with Microsoft's and OpenAI's desktop assistants.

items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-Live-1 full-duplex voice API
items.summary: OpenAI's new GPT-Live-1 model lets voice agents listen and speak simultaneously and handle interruptions naturally, improving full-duplex benchmark performance 30% over its prior voice model, with API pricing set at $0.05 per minute.

items.headline: UBTech's consumer humanoid U1 robots set for first deliveries
items.summary: UBTech says its UWorld U1 companion humanoids, sold in Lite, Pro and Ultra variants priced from about $17,600 to $145,000, have logged over 13,000 pre-orders ahead of first deliveries beginning September 16.
